answer_1.quote: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) , which extend the capabilities of Large Language Models  through sophisticated vision-text feature alignment mechanisms  and autoregressive generation frameworks.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to multimodal inputs (image and instruction), including textual answers for visual questions and full captions for images.
